jobs.description:
The hiring organisation is a well-established European association representing companies across a specialised industrial sector. It plays a central role in supporting its members through major green, digital, and regulatory transformations, working closely with EU institutions, businesses, and expert groups. The association leads strategic initiatives, facilitates knowledge exchange, and supports long-term industry competitiveness and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide day-to-day support to the team manager.
• Track selected policy topics and assist in preparing brief inputs.
• Organise physical and virtual meetings, including agendas and follow-up.
• Handle travel planning and event logistics.
• Coordinate activities of working groups.
• Draft short reports and communication summaries.
• Update webpages, newsletters, and social media posts.
• Maintain contact lists, files, and member resources.

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.
• Strong communication skills in English; other languages are a big plus.
• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

Our partner is part of an international company operating in the retail industry. To strengthen their Sales Support team, they are looking for a German-speaking Sales Support Specialist to assist both Account Managers and customers throughout their projects.

You will join a dynamic and sustainable work environment where growth, collaboration, and respect are at the heart of the company culture. Thanks to a structured onboarding program, you will quickly get up to speed and become a valued member of the team from day one.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• You will work closely with our distributor network & managing projects.
• You will advise customers on the best solutions.
• Throughout each project, you will build and maintain strong commercial relationships with your customers.
• You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.
• You will communicate daily with customers and suppliers to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
• You will handle customer complaints professionally by investigating issues and implementing appropriate solutions, working closely with the Account Manager when needed.
• You will monitor backorders and process product returns accurately and efficiently.
• You will ensure accurate invoicing, prepare credit notes, and follow up on outstanding payments.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who:

• Has a strong customer focus and is passionate about delivering excellent service.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys learning new skills.
• Takes initiative and enjoys working on a variety of projects.
• Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
• Has a positive attitude and enjoys collaborating as part of a team.
• Has a hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
• Is fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.
• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

The company is a large industrial organization operating a high-volume production site with demanding safety standards and large-scale operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Bring structure and consistency to administrative and invoicing processes.
• Ensure work orders are completed accurately and invoiced within the required timelines.
• Support, coach and manage operational teams to improve administrative discipline and compliance.
• Eliminate historical backlogs and resolve outstanding administrative files.
• Implement sustainable procedures and optimize ways of working to improve efficiency and future-proof operations.

• Experience in an industrial or technical environment (technical expertise is not required).
• Strong background in administrative process management and operational excellence.
• Proven ability to lead teams, drive change and improve adherence to procedures.
• Hands-on, resilient and capable of following issues through to completion.
• Fluent in Dutch and French; English is considered an asset.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

Digitribe is looking for a Cloud Project Manager to lead the governance and delivery of a large-scale cloud migration programme at one of our clients, a major player in the financial services sector. You'll be the person who keeps multiple cloud workstreams aligned on plans, budgets, risks and decisions.

You'll join a cloud migration project built around several workstreams: migrations, platform foundations and landing zones. Product Owners define priorities, Solution Architects design the solutions and Change Managers drive adoption. You make sure it all comes together, and you report to programme-level governance.
Your role

• Set up and run the governance of the cloud delivery organisation: cadence, decision forums, controls and accountabilities

• Build and maintain the integrated cloud migration roadmap across all workstreams

• Prepare and facilitate the steering committee, follow up on decisions and escalate when needed

• Track budgets, forecasts, actuals and funding gaps, and trigger corrective actions

• Manage risks, blockers and dependencies across infrastructure, security, architecture, platform teams and external partners

• Deliver clear management reporting and challenge reported status and dates

• Make sure decisions turn into concrete actions and milestones are delivered

• 8+ years in project or programme management within complex IT transformations

• Proven experience running senior steering committees and multi-team governance

• Strong skills in planning, roadmaps, risks and dependency management

• Solid financial follow-up: budgets, forecasts, actuals, Etc

• Experience in financial services or another regulated environment

• Cloud migration experience on Azure

• MSP, PMP, Prince2 or SAFe certifications are a plus

• Fluent English; French and/or Dutch is a plus

The company is a not-for-profit making organisation which represents large, medium and small companies across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

Mission of the role:

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?

For the Executive Director, you will:
	
• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc.	
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director	
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits….	
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents).	
• Manage the Extranet/Website.	
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets	
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.	
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:
	
• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level	
• Excellent written and oral communication skills	
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills	
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.	
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)	
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly	
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation	
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

jobs.occupation: Relationship Support Associate - 6 months contract - M/F/X
jobs.description:
The Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) role involves supporting corporate banking processes with precision and efficiency. This position requires a strong command of English and attention to detail to ensure effective operations.

Client Details

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.
• Provide support for audits and other compliance activities.Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking)

A successful Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) should have:

• A strong command of English, both written and spoken.
• Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in finance or similar.
• Experience or knowledge in the financial services industry.
• Proficiency in using banking systems and tools.
• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.
• Applicants must already be based in Belgium and possess valid authorization to work in Belgium at the time of application.

One of the most important players in the bank sector in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

In charge of the control of KYC files : based on local and cross-border requirements and internal  process: 
	
• adverse info check	
• analysis of the information received	
• collaboration with the KYC Coordinator to ensure the respect of deadlines	
• treatment of partial triggers

Collaboration with the KYC Coordinator, the Middle office and/or with compliance departments to discuss potential issues and find solutions.
Communicate on the progress  (and in case of potential difficulties)  with the team leader.
Communications to colleagues will be done in French, Dutch or English.
 

	
• Dutch: Fluent	
• French: Fluent	
• English: Good knowledge (understanding, writing and speaking)	
• Minimum Bachelor education or equivalent by experience	
• At least  5  years of experience.	
• Technical experience: IT tools (Excel, Outlook, Word, PDF)	
• Business experience:  Relevant education (economical, juridical, business management), preferably also commercial experience

• Good knowledge of ABAP and ABAP OO: reports' modification and correction, debugging...

• You have experience in many phases of SAP HR/HCM projects: analyze, implementation, deployment, support, project management

• You are customer-oriented

-

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Head of Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

 

 

 

As the Head of Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Head of Systems Engineering - Robotics you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.
